summary: Anatomy ontologies (Uberon, VSAO, HAO) are open and record some relations such as 'attached to', and MorphoSource holds 209,875 specimen scans from which size and shape can be measured. No fetched resource is a comparative table of element-by-element connection order across classes, and MorphoBank was blocked (403) to scripted access.
next_step: Choose one class (e.g. tetrapod limb) and compile a connection-order table from MorphoSource scans or MorphoBank limb matrices, with a homology standard fixed beforehand.
